description: Create a crypto deposit invoice to buy credits: USDC on Base or BTC on-chain. No signup and no card. Pay the exact amount and address in the returned uri; the credits are added automatically after the payment confirms. The amount is unique so the payment can be matched. Poll deposit_status to see when it is credited.

account_key.description: The account_key returned by create_account (or send it as Authorization: Bearer).

rail.description: Payment rail: usdc-base (USDC on Base) or btc (Bitcoin on-chain).

usd.description: Amount to deposit in US dollars (1-500). Credits = floor(usd / 0.0001).

name: create_deposit
title: Create deposit
